titulo: A fake WhatsApp clone is showing up before the real version on the Play Store
cuerpo: After a Chrome clone was spotted on the Play Store earlier this week, a user on Reddit says they're seeing a fake version of WhatsApp in a "sponsored" slot above the real version.
